ig_caption:
20 skills, and my agent barely notices. Here's why 🧠

Progressive disclosure, 3 levels:
1️⃣ always: each skill's name + description
2️⃣ task matched: that one skill's instructions
3️⃣ only if needed: its reference doc or script

Real count from my demo folder (≈ chars/4):
✅ level 1: ~674 tokens
❌ load everything: ~47,468 tokens

Same skills. A tiny fraction of the context.

Part 3/5 of AI Skills Explained. Ask me anything in the comments, I answer every one.

#AIAgents #AgentSkills #GenAI #LLM #AIArchitect
